header.offline: Backend unreachable: the preview works, downloads and requests do not.

download.check: Check {n} thing before printing | Check {n} things before printing
download.nothing: ✓ Nothing to fix for a {nozzle} nozzle. Pick a file type below.
download.threeMfDesc: Two colours as named parts, already on filaments 1–3. For AMS and other multi-material printers.
download.stlPairDesc: Body and enamel as two STL files, for slicers that do not read 3MF parts.
download.stlDesc: Geometry only. For two tones on one nozzle, swap filament at the heights above.
download.timeout: the server took too long. Try again in a moment.
download.notWatertight: the coin could not be built as a solid. This is a bug; please report the design.
download.copied: Design JSON copied to the clipboard.
download.copyFailed: The clipboard is not available here. Use Save file instead.
download.threeMfPrusaDesc: The same parts laid out the way PrusaSlicer reads them, on extruders 1–3.
download.size: {d} mm across · {h} mm thick · about {g} g of PLA
download.swaps: One nozzle? Pause and swap filament at the first layer at or above: {list}. The edge shows the colour bands.
download.confirm: {n} problem will likely spoil the print | {n} problems will likely spoil the print
download.confirmHint: They are marked ⚑ above. Fix them, keep them with “Keep as is”, or download anyway.

tabs.faceHint: Texts, emblem and enamel of the {face} face only.
tabs.coinHint: Size, edge, metal and lettering, shared by both faces.

preview.bothHint: Both faces at the same scale. The 3D view arrives in phase 4.
preview.iconHint: Drag the emblem to move it · scroll to resize · shift+scroll to rotate · corner and top handles when selected.
preview.warningsOnFace: {n} thing to check on this face | {n} things to check on this face

three.dragHint: Drag to turn the coin · scroll to zoom
three.offline: The 3D view needs the server, which is not reachable. Both faces are shown flat.

errors.busy: The server is busy; the last coin stays until it catches up.
errors.not_watertight: The coin could not be built as a solid. This is a bug; the last good coin stays.
errors.invalid: The server rejected this design. The last good coin stays.
errors.network: The 3D view could not update; the last good coin stays.

inscription.dots: Separator dots between the two texts
inscription.missingGlyph: The font has no glyph for: {chars}

emblem.placeholderKind: A compass rose until you upload a logo
emblem.uploadHint: PNG, JPEG or SVG, up to 10 MB. Dark shapes on a light background trace best.
emblem.uploadOffline: PNG, JPEG or SVG, up to 10 MB. Tracing needs the server, which is not reachable right now.
emblem.dragHint: Or drag the emblem on the preview.

colour.copyFrom: Copy emblem and enamel from the {face}
colour.source: Colours are colorimeter readings of printed samples from filamentcolors.xyz, not vendor charts.
colour.unknown: This filament is no longer in the list. Pick another.

picker.noMatch: No filament matches. Try fewer words.
picker.measuredHint: Colorimeter reading of a printed sample, from filamentcolors.xyz. This is the colour the preview uses.
picker.overrideHint: Our own colorimeter reading. It replaces the filamentcolors.xyz value in the preview.

size.hint: Thickness is the body; relief is how far letters and emblem stand out on each face.

lettering.hint: One font for the whole coin. TTF, OTF or WOFF, up to 2 MB.
lettering.uploadOffline: Font upload needs the server, which is not reachable right now.

printer.hint: Used only for the condition checks. Not sure? Leave it at 0.4 mm.
printer.enamelHint: How deep the enamel colour goes in the two-colour files: {n} layer at {layer} mm. | How deep the enamel colour goes in the two-colour files: {n} layers at {layer} mm. Two layers hide the body colour under most filaments.

advanced.hint: Design units: 320 across the coin. The tuned values come from printed coins; change them when you know why.

templates.title: Start from a lot
templates.intro: Pick a template, then change the texts and colours. Everything stays editable.
templates.openFile: Have a .coin.json from earlier? {link}. Templates are anonymised examples.
templates.offline: Templates come from the server, which is not reachable right now.

request.title: Request a print
request.intro: Daniel prints the coin for you and gets back to you by email about colours, quantity and price.
request.name: Your name
request.messagePlaceholder: How many coins, and by when?
request.sent: ✓ Sent to Daniel{what}. He will reply to {email}. Nothing is stored on the server.
request.needName: Add your name so Daniel knows who it is from.
request.needEmail: That email address does not look complete.
request.tooFast: Give it a few seconds, then send again.
request.failed: The request could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
request.offline: The server is not reachable right now, so the request cannot be sent.

importError.title: That file could not be opened

toasts.restored: Restored your last design from this browser.
toasts.saved: Saved {file}. Open it later to keep editing, or send it to someone.
toasts.openedUnchecked: Opened {file}. The server is away, so it was not checked.

dropzone.hint: Drop a file here or choose one.
dropzone.wrongType: That file type is not supported here.

trace.title: Trace a logo
trace.hint: The outline updates as you change the knobs.
trace.dropLargest: Drop the largest shape (a badge outline)

errors.tooLarge: The image is too large for the server. Shrink it and try again.
errors.rejected: The server could not trace this image.
errors.network: The server is not reachable, so the image could not be traced.

warnings.looks_like_badge: This looks like a whole badge: try dropping the largest shape and keeping the inner disc.
warnings.thin_ring_dropped: A thin ring was dropped; it would not print.
warnings.n_parts_kept: Only the biggest shapes were kept.
warnings.touches_edge: The drawing touches the image edge; it may be cut off.
warnings.icon_simplified: The outline was simplified to keep the file small.
warnings.photo_like: This looks like a photo; a flat logo traces better.
warnings.outside_inner_disc_dropped: Shapes outside the inner disc were dropped.

fontUpload.title: Upload a font
fontUpload.intro: TTF, OTF, WOFF or WOFF2, up to 2 MB.
fontUpload.hint: Drop a font here or choose one. Larger than 2 MB? Convert it to WOFF2 first.
fontUpload.licence: The font is embedded in your design file and sent to the server only to build your coin. Make sure you may use it.

errors.tooLarge: That font is larger than 2 MB. Convert it to WOFF2 and try again.
errors.rejected: The server could not read this font.
errors.network: The server is not reachable, so the font could not be checked.
errors.read: The font file could not be read in this browser.

warnings.no_lowercase: No lowercase letters: lowercase text will show as missing glyphs.
warnings.no_digits: No digits: numbers will show as missing glyphs.
warnings.variable_font: A variable font: the default instance is used.
